caption: The drawing depicts a metallic tool with two elongated handles that converge and are joined by a pivot, forming a pincer-like structure. The tool is rendered in shades of brass and gold, with a few grayish metallic elements, particularly at the joining pivot and on a cylindrical component at the end of one jaw. The jaws are short, parallel, and each has a rectangular form; one jaw has an additional circular metal element above it. The tool is shown against an off-white or light beige background with no other objects or decorations present, centered on the page and positioned at a slight angle, with the handles extending toward the upper left and the jaws toward the lower right.
title: Bullet Mold
